title: Checkout Place
statement: Implement `solve(amount)`. If `amount` is not a positive int, return `error`. Otherwise charge that amount through an injected client and return `ok:{amount}`. The checkout object does not choose a concrete URL. It calls the client it was given.
hints: A tiny client records the amount and returns ok.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Composition is Checkout holding a client, not subclassing a payment vendor.

editorial: Composition is Checkout holding a client, not subclassing a payment vendor. The test double is the client. Validation stays in checkout so a fake client is not the only line of defense. The returned string is the charge the client saw.
